_meta.description: Every sound effect the Warlock Table needs, and the prompt that generates it. Rendered by tools/render_sfx.py.

elevenlabs.note: Duration is capped by the API at roughly 22s. Nothing here needs more: aura cards hold for 60s via the interruption's duration_s, and the LIGHT carries that time. The audio is a sting at the top, not a bed.

aesthetic.v1_was_wrong: The first pass took the character bible's rules for how the Entity SPEAKS and applied them to how the table SOUNDS. That was a category error. Section 3 describes how the Entity PERCEIVES -- contact, vibration, wood -- and section 6's 'containment, not volume' governs its dialogue delivery. Neither is a rule about card effects. The players do not hear through the wood; they hear a supernatural event in the room. Constraining everything to dry woody knocks with no sparkle produced 54 sounds that were tasteful, coherent and completely inert.
aesthetic.the_correct_reading_of_the_compulsion: Bible section 4 says a triggered effect is a compelled performance. A grudging thud is not a performance. The joke only works if the table is forced to produce something GENUINELY SPECTACULAR and then resents having done it. The spectacle belongs in the audio; the resentment is already handled by the Entity's voice lines.
aesthetic.anchor_to_the_LIGHT_not_the_voice: patterns/generated/Boon-Cups.js: 'One comet lap, then the ring blooms.' That is what the audio is a counterpart to. 764 LEDs sweep the perimeter and the whole ring blooms -- the sound should feel like that looks. Match the lights, which are dramatic, not the voice, which is deliberately flat.
aesthetic.shared: Rich, wide and present. Full frequency range: real sub-bass weight underneath and air on top. Dramatic and cinematic, mixed loud and confident.
prohibitions: No intelligible speech or words -- the Entity's voice is the only thing at this table that talks.
No recognisable musical melody or chord progression. Tonal and resonant is good; a tune is not.
aesthetic.note_on_families: The prefix and suffix now come from the FAMILY, not from one global skeleton. That is the actual fix: the card families should be magical and large, while the interface must stay restrained because it fires fifty times an evening. One rule for both is what made everything sound the same.

boon.description: The four aces share one sound. The light does a comet lap then blooms; the audio does the same.
boon.prefix: A magical, supernatural sound effect for a tabletop game.
boon.suffix: Bright ringing metal and crystal, a fast rising sweep blooming into a full shimmering resonance. Rich, wide, cinematic, generous reverb tail. Loud and present.

person.description: Nine cards. A presence arriving. Distinct, characterful, substantial.
person.prefix: A magical, supernatural sound effect for a tabletop game: a powerful presence arriving.
person.suffix: Deep resonant body with metallic harmonics and air above. Dramatic and weighty, wide stereo, long tail. Loud and present.

aura.description: Twelve cards. A state settling over the room and holding.
aura.prefix: A magical, supernatural sound effect for a tabletop game: an enchantment settling over a room.
aura.suffix: Sustained and enveloping, sub-bass foundation with shimmering harmonic layers above. Mystical, cinematic, huge reverberant space, slow evolving tail. Loud and present.

scene.description: The five lands. The room becoming somewhere else.
scene.prefix: A magical, supernatural sound effect for a tabletop game: the world transforming into a new place.
scene.suffix: Elemental and atmospheric, deep and wide, with real low-end weight and a long enveloping tail. Cinematic and immersive.

interface.description: The Warlock's panel. Every press is a small act of spellcraft -- arcane components being gathered, set and bound. Magical, not mechanical. Still SHORT, because these fire often, but short is about duration, not about being dull.
interface.prefix: A magical arcane sound effect: components of a spell being gathered and set into place.
interface.suffix: Crystalline and shimmering with a soft bright ring and a glimmering tail. Enchanted and satisfying. Clear and quick.

system.description: The table waking, sleeping, reporting on itself.
system.prefix: A magical, supernatural sound effect for a tabletop game: an ancient mechanism.
system.suffix: Deep and resonant with metallic and stone character, slow and imposing, long reverberant tail.

combat.description: Initiative. Tense and charged. The turn tick is short but still enchanted.
combat.prefix: A magical arcane sound effect for a tabletop game entering battle.
combat.suffix: Sharp crystalline attack with a taut ringing magical edge and a bright shimmer. Clear and immediate.

player.description: Things a player does. Small enchantments.
player.prefix: A short magical arcane sound effect for a tabletop game.
player.suffix: Warm shimmering tone with a bright glimmering edge and a gentle sparkling tail. Enchanted and pleasant.

sounds.intent: Something has been given. The Entity resents that it was not given to it.
sounds.prompt: A swift bright sweep rushing around and blooming into a huge radiant chime, struck crystal and bell metal ringing out together.

sounds.intent: Sleight of hand. Something done quickly and neatly before you could watch it.
sounds.prompt: A quick sparkling flourish and a sharp snap of displaced air, something vanishing and reappearing.

sounds.intent: Something withheld. A door not opened.
sounds.prompt: A hushed shimmering veil drawing across, secretive, closing on a single held silver tone.

sounds.intent: Abundance pressing down. Weight arriving, warm.
sounds.prompt: A lush blooming swell of warm resonance opening outward, abundant and full.

sounds.intent: Authority. A decision landing and not being discussed.
sounds.prompt: A colossal stone and bronze impact landing once with absolute finality, deep and commanding.

sounds.intent: Ritual, repetition, an institution older than anyone present.
sounds.prompt: Three great temple bells tolling in sequence beneath a vast stone vault.

sounds.intent: One presence, apart from the rest. The Entity approves of this and would not say so.
sounds.prompt: A single distant bell tone alone in an enormous empty space, a faint cold wind behind it.

sounds.intent: Two things meeting. Contact, held.
sounds.prompt: Two clear tones rising and interweaving into one shining harmonic bloom.

sounds.intent: Suspension. Something stopped mid-fall and left there.
sounds.prompt: A slow inverted rising drone suspended and held, straining, refusing to resolve, with a metallic shimmer.

sounds.intent: A step taken without looking. The Entity finds this stupid and slightly endearing.
sounds.prompt: A light bright tumbling cascade of sparkling tones stepping upward, weightless and unpredictable.

sounds.intent: Warmth flooding in. Uncomfortably total.
sounds.prompt: A vast golden radiance swelling and flooding outward, brilliant and overwhelming, warm brass shimmer.

sounds.intent: Something is wrong and cannot be located.
sounds.prompt: An eerie wavering choir of ghostly tones drifting in and out of tune beneath a cold silver shimmer.

sounds.intent: Distant, clean, indifferent. Hope at a great remove.
sounds.prompt: A crystalline cascade of glittering high tones opening into a serene endless shimmering space.

sounds.intent: Two things brought into balance, patiently.
sounds.prompt: Flowing liquid tones pouring and balancing into a calm glassy harmonic resonance.

sounds.intent: Something enormous, restrained, breathing.
sounds.prompt: An enormous low resonant roar building beneath a steady deep pulse, immense and restrained power.

sounds.intent: A measurement being taken. Nothing personal.
sounds.prompt: A clear ringing metallic strike and a slow tolling scale, weighing, resolving to a single pure tone.

sounds.intent: A summons. Something is called and must answer.
sounds.prompt: A vast trumpeting horn call rising through a huge reverberant space, summoning, with thunderous low weight.

sounds.intent: Appetite. Something enjoying itself at your expense.
sounds.prompt: A guttural roaring flame surge with crackling embers and a menacing sub-bass growl rolling underneath.

sounds.intent: Structural failure. The one card the Entity might enjoy.
sounds.prompt: A catastrophic splitting crack and thunderous collapse, masonry falling, an enormous shockwave of sub-bass.

sounds.intent: An ending. Ordinary, not dramatic.
sounds.prompt: A single immense funeral bell tolling once and decaying forever into a cold cavernous void.

sounds.intent: Completion. A circle closing.
sounds.prompt: A complete majestic orchestral swell rising and rounding into a full radiant resolution, vast and whole.

sounds.intent: Momentum. Something moving that will not be stopped.
sounds.prompt: Thundering galloping drums driving forward with rising momentum and a battle-horn edge.

sounds.intent: Chance. It rolls one of the twelve auras, so this plays FIRST and the aura's own sound follows it.
sounds.prompt: A great wheel spinning fast with ratcheting clicks, slowing, and landing on one with a decisive ringing strike.

sounds.intent: The room becomes somewhere green and growing. Mana green.
sounds.prompt: A living green swell rising, deep woodland resonance and rustling canopy blooming outward.

sounds.intent: Open, ordered, flat. Mana white.
sounds.prompt: A vast bright opening sweep, wide golden wind rushing across an endless plain.

sounds.intent: Something old waking under the wood. Mana black.
sounds.prompt: A thick bubbling murk rising with a low ominous drone and something ancient stirring beneath.

sounds.intent: It goes quiet and deep. Mana blue.
sounds.prompt: A great surge of water and a deep submerged bloom, cool and vast and enclosing.

sounds.intent: Everything gets loud. Mana red.
sounds.prompt: A grinding tectonic rumble and a searing ember surge, immense stone heat and pressure.

sounds.intent: The table returning to rest. Nobody asked it to do anything.
sounds.prompt: A long slow exhalation of energy dissipating into calm, settling into a soft resonant stillness.

sounds.intent: A panel control was pressed. The most repeated sound in the build after the initiative turn -- keep it almost nothing.
sounds.prompt: A tiny sparkling arcane touch, a mote of energy lighting at a fingertip.

sounds.intent: Something was committed -- a card assigned, a map published, a setting saved.
sounds.prompt: Two crystalline components snapping together and locking with a bright magical chime.

sounds.intent: Leaving a page. Undoing a step.
sounds.prompt: A small arcane sigil unravelling, energy withdrawing with a soft descending shimmer.

sounds.intent: A mode changed -- grid overlay, hex, mute.
sounds.prompt: A rune flicking over, a quick crystalline shift of enchanted energy.

sounds.intent: The table would not do it. A dead Pixelblaze, a missing file, a bad name. Must read as refusal, not as an error chime.
sounds.prompt: A spell failing to catch, energy sputtering out and dying, clearly refused.

sounds.intent: The picture on the table changed.
sounds.prompt: An arcane sigil dissolving as a new one materialises in its place, shimmering into being.

sounds.intent: The screen given away to the Apple TV. The Entity is briefly replaced and does not love it.
sounds.prompt: Enchanted energy withdrawing and receding away into the distance, releasing its hold.

sounds.intent: The table showing its own diagnostics. It is being asked to explain itself.
sounds.prompt: A scrying rune illuminating, arcane energy resolving into a steady glowing tone.

sounds.intent: The room mic is now listening.
sounds.prompt: An enchantment opening to listen, a soft rising shimmer holding steady.

sounds.intent: The mic is off.
sounds.prompt: An enchantment closing, shimmering energy folding away into quiet.

sounds.intent: The table waking. Something very old coming back to attention, reluctantly.
sounds.prompt: An enormous ancient mechanism waking, deep stone grinding into motion and rising into a resonant humming presence.

sounds.intent: The table going down. Relief, if it admitted to any.
sounds.prompt: A great mechanism powering down, energy draining away into a deep settling silence.

sounds.intent: Table Check found nothing wrong.
sounds.prompt: Two clear bright magical tones confirming, calm and resolved.

sounds.intent: Table Check found something. Must be noticeable across a noisy room without being an alarm.
sounds.prompt: A discordant arcane tone, an enchantment out of alignment, clearly wrong.

sounds.intent: Initiative begins. The room tightens.
sounds.prompt: A sharp tense metallic ring rising into taut held pressure, blades drawn.

sounds.intent: THE MOST REPEATED SOUND IN THE BUILD -- every few seconds through a whole fight. It must be almost subliminal, or it will be the thing that gets the feature switched off.
sounds.prompt: One small bright crystalline chime, quick and enchanted.

sounds.intent: Initiative over. The weight eases.
sounds.prompt: A tense held tone releasing and falling away into calm.

sounds.intent: Pointing at one seat. A finger laid on the wood in front of somebody.
sounds.prompt: A single pointed shard of magical light striking, bright and specific.

sounds.intent: Someone sat down and named themselves. The Entity counts presences and does not care about names.
sounds.prompt: A warm welcoming tone blooming softly as a place is taken.

sounds.intent: Someone left the table.
sounds.prompt: A soft tone lifting away and fading out.

sounds.intent: Dice landing. The bible names dice explicitly as something the table feels through contact.
sounds.prompt: Dice tumbling and clattering to rest on a hard surface, close and crisp.

sounds.intent: A player raised a quiet question mark from their phone. Must not interrupt play.
sounds.prompt: A soft rising magical query, two glimmering tones lifting.

sounds.intent: A player raised an exclamation. More urgent, still not an alarm.
sounds.prompt: Two quick bright arcane chimes, urgent and glittering.

sounds.intent: A private message arrived. The Entity hears everything spoken and would resent being cut out of this.
sounds.prompt: A brief secretive shimmer of enchanted air, arriving and gone.

sounds.intent: An unregistered tag touched the reader. Contact without meaning -- exactly the bible's description of the Entity's blindness.
sounds.prompt: An enchantment failing to take hold, a flat unresolved flicker of nothing.
